blocks.text: Truck Numbers, Decals & Lettering are very popular for commercial wraps designed to mark a company brand.
A partial truck wrap is a cost effective commercial wrap to creatively feature a company brand.  Many companies choose to wrap the box of a truck and sometimes only a tailgate wrap.
A full truck wrap is popular choice for a colour change and when a bold statement for a commercial wrap is desired.
